status_semantics.implemented: Original bridge acceptance contract is fully exercised; no bridge is assigned this status merely by analogy.
status_semantics.partially_closes: Current source/receipts implement a directly reusable subset; remaining original acceptance gaps are explicit.
status_semantics.not_addressed: Original bridge-specific behavior is absent; adjacent reusable infrastructure may exist.

summary.fresh_audit_scope: Read source and existing executed receipts; recomputed only artifact/source SHA identities. Did not rerun Blender, scientific models, native browser, or original private kits.

bridges.title: Splat round-trip ladder
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Research Loom has durable deterministic case packets, manifest hashes, explicit geometric tolerances and negative controls for meshes/lines/points.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No GaussianSplats, SH0–SH3 fields, opacity/logit clamp fixtures, real splat datasets or X_ITE-vs-splat-oracle PSNR are in this study.
bridges.integration_action: Reuse manifest, source binding and expected-loss patterns for a separate splat fixture suite; preserve historical splat numbers as reported until their exact bytes and pins are recovered.

bridges.title: Validator large-attribute verdict
bridges.current_implemented_elements: The pinned adapter has an explicit 2 MiB input cap and records an input refusal separately from pass/fail of XSD/semantic checks.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No large-attribute ladder, huge_tree patch or XSD engine ceiling was executed by Research Loom. Bounded small scenes cannot substantiate a large-splat fix.
bridges.integration_action: Adopt its honest scoped refusal vocabulary, then recover or rebuild the historical large-attribute fixtures under the selected validator pin and explicit parser budgets.

bridges.title: Splat export slabs
bridges.current_implemented_elements: The Blender source text block is compressed and line-chunked to avoid a real long-line performance pathology.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: That source-text envelope is not GaussianSplats spatial/depth slabbing, and no render-order or per-attribute size claims follow from it.
bridges.integration_action: Keep the text-envelope performance fix separate; specify slabbing against measured attribute bytes, scientific field retention and compositing order.

bridges.title: Importer value correctness
bridges.current_implemented_elements: An owned adapter uses proper Y-up/Z-up rotation, explicit sRGB/linear conversion, actual vertex/glyph/tube readback and scalar-appearance comparisons. External stock and fork routes have separate executed mixed-fixture loss receipts.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No broad fork material/default/Unlit/light-energy regression pack is delivered; the owned adapter is not a repair of the external fork.
bridges.integration_action: Promote the asymmetric fixture and actual-coordinate mutation control into a handoff pack for x3d-blender-io; add field-specific tolerances and material/default controls without broadening current success claims.

bridges.title: Blender agent guard
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Study publication is gated before index replacement; canonical packet/frame bytes, producer hashes and declared witness inequalities are checked. Imports are bound to exact canonical packet bytes and stale producer processes refuse requests.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: This is not a sandbox for arbitrary bpy scripts, a Blender MCP preflight, an agent repair loop or a complete feature-loss audit.
bridges.integration_action: Wrap existing deterministic gates with a thin script-lane runner whose contracts distinguish eligibility, unsupported data and execution failure. Add pre-export loss rules rather than inferring completeness from XSD success.

bridges.title: Look parity chart
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Data colors are declared sRGB; explicit piecewise conversion is measured, studio Blender renders use Standard display transform, and GLB serialization is compared separately from BYTE_COLOR reimport.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No cross-renderer numeric chart, ΔE/PSNR gate, alpha sorting chart or native X_ITE pixels were executed here. A beautiful Blender render is not a look-parity result.
bridges.integration_action: Reuse color fixtures but run paired unlit/value-preserving chart measurements with common camera/exposure/background before judging scene appearance.

bridges.title: Importer must-not-raise corpus suite
bridges.current_implemented_elements: The owned bounded X3D reader rejects unsupported/static-subset violations and unsafe/malformed inputs; unit tests exercise actual coordinate edits and invalid topology. Actual Blender-coordinate tampering is caught.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No 585-scene corpus or 3,649 mutant set was inspected or executed in this map, and no general external-importer crash result is established.
bridges.integration_action: Use source-hashed failure fixtures and expected refusals in a corpus manifest; retain crashes, unsupported features and preflight-invalid inputs as distinct outcomes.

bridges.title: Splat oracle ordering
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Saved frame identity and temporal selection are explicit; no frontend interpolation invents model states.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No splat software oracle, overlapping-splat ordering ladder, camera-view PSNR or transparency ordering experiment exists in this study.
bridges.integration_action: Implement with the splat ladder after the coordinate/SH/color contracts are fixed; retain known-answer images and renderer identity per pose.

bridges.title: Scientific semantic checks
bridges.current_implemented_elements: 63 application-level witnesses separately check ABC field identities/integration, covariance/eigenbasis/quadratic forms and membrane boundaries/energy/spectrum. Generic XSD and implemented semantic checks are recorded separately.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: The historical 12-id sci-semantic patch was not recovered or adopted, and new local model tests are not generic units/legend/pLDDT validator rules.
bridges.integration_action: Map recurring scientific failures to a namespaced finding catalog with machine-readable variable, units, model assumption, evidence and remediation; keep advisory generic lints distinct from mathematical acceptance gates.

bridges.title: Scientific fixture factory
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Nine reproducible Python-authored research cases generate 78 static frames, raw datasets and metadata-bearing exports; all candidates must pass before publication. VTP carries named scientific arrays, units and explicit validity masks; VTI checks actual lattice ordering.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: The factory is not Blender-first and does not cover molecular pLDDT/PAE, volumes, splats or arbitrary Blender attributes. X3D raw-array reconstruction is explicitly outside its subset.
bridges.integration_action: Adopt one canonical fixture schema with analytic/raw arrays distinct from geometry and appearance. Expand by data topology only after preserving current measured contracts.

bridges.title: Corpus tiers and loss ledger
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Current case inventory and per-route expected/observed losses are durable. External route status=pass means executed; retention_status=lossy records omission separately.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No PolyXandria spine A–D reclassification, 585-scene rerun or generalized per-object loss ledger was executed here.
bridges.integration_action: Generalize the case/route evidence into per-feature ledger rows; do not count an object as retained merely because the exporter completed.

bridges.title: Figure provenance chain
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Packets, producers, selected frames, adapters, tools, native scientific blends, GLBs and PNGs have cross-bound hashes. Current release runner checks actual retained artifacts and frame/tool binding; server imports prevent stale source/packet labeling.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: These unsigned local receipts do not implement the historical x3dprov chain, renderer-stamped chain heads, authentication, signatures or Library lineage ingestion.
bridges.integration_action: Adopt existing exact-byte identities as entities and existing transformations as activities, then define canonical payload/chain hash rules before integrating x3dprov. Preserve source claim vs edited geometry history.

bridges.title: Blender 5.3 native readiness
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Actual executed runtime is Blender5.2.4 LTS with recorded official archive identity.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No Blender5.3/native GaussianSplats execution or current capability refresh is supplied by Research Loom. Old daily-build/PyPI statements from October must not be carried forward as current facts.
bridges.integration_action: Treat 5.2.4 as a proven baseline; establish a separate 5.3 feature probe and CI dimension from newly verified primary sources and an actual runtime.

bridges.title: Flywheel orchestration graph
bridges.current_implemented_elements: tools/check.py provides a deterministic release sequence and source-drift checks; it is a useful node boundary.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No LangGraph checkpointed graph, writer/repair loop, human-gate node or automated rule promotion is present in Research Loom.
bridges.integration_action: Begin with a dependency-light state machine wrapping current tools and typed outcomes; add orchestration framework bindings only after resume/idempotency/identity semantics are exercised.

bridges.title: Three-way/data-fidelity attacker metric
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Separate scientific, structural, geometry-transfer and offline-render evidence exists, with known-bad controls; actual VTK readers and Blender save/reopen provide independent representation checks.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: There is no native X_ITE visibility arm, DSPy metric, red-team search, calibrated judge panel or agent-generated held-out set in this study.
bridges.integration_action: Expose an evidence vector rather than a multiplied binary score. Preserve not_run/unsupported/refused separately; promote minimal failures to fixtures before any learned judge optimization.

bridges.title: SPZ compact sidecar
bridges.current_implemented_elements: A lossless compressed source-packet envelope exists inside Blender Text.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: This is neither SPZ decode/encode nor a scientific compressed-geometry sidecar, and conveys no SPZ/SOG compatibility.
bridges.integration_action: Keep container/source compression and splat field compression separate in the taxonomy; recover the historical decoder and define axis/SH/quantization tests before integrating.

bridges.title: Licence passport
bridges.current_implemented_elements: Vendored X_ITE and validator source include license and origin manifests, with hashes checked by the release tooling. Case sources are preserved as source references.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: Source citations and vendor licenses are not a per-input/per-derived-artifact licence passport or redistribution decision; no spine classifier was audited here.
bridges.integration_action: Add explicit license assertions with source artifact, actor, assertion date, scope and unknown status; keep legal constraints out of the scientific validity predicate.

bridges.title: Agent lane A/B benchmark
bridges.current_implemented_elements: The three analytic families and measured counterexamples can supply a small deterministic benchmark seed.
bridges.remaining_acceptance_gap: No 115-prompt benchmark, Blender agent arm, x3d_mcp writer arm, API spend, randomization or judge calibration was run by Research Loom.
bridges.integration_action: Design matched prompts and equal tool budgets only after guard, data-fidelity oracles and held-out fixtures are stable; use cached/manual baselines before paid runs.

candidate_bridge_updates.current: Three science-only GLBs actually export/reimport in Blender5.2.4; actual expanded geometry and identity extras are measured. Serialized FLOAT colors are exact in selected fixtures; reimport BYTE_COLOR is quantized within recorded bound.
candidate_bridge_updates.gap: No USD arm, external second glTF runtime, Khronos Neutral cross-renderer comparison or material-transmission/IOR/volume suite.

candidate_bridge_updates.current: The owned subset preserves points/lines/colors and actual geometry readback. The ordinary PointSet omission in the modern fork is now directly recorded for its mixed fixture.
candidate_bridge_updates.gap: No broad PointCloud exporter repair, PointSet ColorRGBA alpha chart, pixel point-size calibration or native X_ITE/Cycles equivalence.
